exposure: modified B-Lynch sutures at the fundus and part of the corpus uteri
cohort: 40 women with postpartum haemorrhage caused by uterine inertia during caesarean section in women with twin pregnancy
finding: Modified B-Lynch sutures at the fundus and part of the corpus uteri can achieve a haemostatic effect similar to that of the classic B-Lynch suture, while it allows for a shortened operative time and reduced postoperative complications.
